metadata.title: Oncel & Wilson (2006) Marmara Sea seismic research-region subdivisions (15 zones)
metadata.source: Oncel, A.O. and Wilson, T. (2006), Tectonophysics, 418, 205-218, doi:10.1016/j.tecto.2006.02.006
metadata.source_figure: Figure 1 (map panel, raster image embedded on PDF page 209)
metadata.study_area_text: Paper text: 39.76 to 41 N latitude, 26.3 to 30.0 E longitude
metadata.geometry_method: Figure 1 raster extracted natively from the PDF (no re-render/no resampling); axis calibrated from tick-mark pixel positions, not gridline guesses (x-scale 301.57 px/deg from 8 ticks 26.5-30.0E; y-scale 349.0 px/deg from 3 ticks 40.0/40.5/41.0N, cross-checked against the bottom frame landing at 39.771N vs the paper's stated 39.76N -- 0.011deg / ~1.2km agreement). All 15 zone boundaries were detected as dark-pixel-run line segments in the calibrated frame, deduplicated into 16 canonical shared boundary lines (8 lon, 8 lat) so adjacent zones share IDENTICAL edge coordinates (verified: sum of the 15 zone areas equals the outer frame's area to within floating-point rounding, i.e. exact tiling, no gaps/no overlaps), then re-drawn as a semi-transparent overlay on the original image and visually confirmed against the source's own printed boundary lines (see verify_left.png / verify_right.png).
metadata.known_deviation: Zone 13 has an unexplained diagonal line near its NW corner in the source figure, not connected to any other zone number; treated as a non-boundary annotation (fault trace or label leader line, not resolved) and excluded from the digitized polygon, which is a simple rectangle.
metadata.digitized_by: Claude (pixel digitization from the user's Zotero PDF copy), reviewed against a rendered verification overlay
metadata.not_included: The 25-zone / 3-macro-zone Oncel & Wilson (2004) western Anatolia regionalization is a separate, irregular (non-grid) figure and is explicitly NOT part of this Phase-0 dataset.
